name: Scout Status Writeback
description: Sync MC status signals back to business M365 sources

steps.label: Sync status changes
steps.prompt:
Call mc_scout_status_sync to get Scout-originated tasks that changed status since last sync.

For each completed/cancelled task:
- If source was work email: Record that this thread should not be re-pushed unless new actionable context appears. Do not send a reply or mutate the message unless explicitly requested by the user.
- If source was a Planner task: Mark the Planner task complete only if the task was originally pushed from Planner and MC has an explicit completion.
- If source was a meeting action item: No write-back needed (informational).

For tasks that were snoozed in MC: Remember not to re-push these items in future triage runs until the snooze expires.

Report a brief summary of write-backs performed.
